highlights.title: Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter
highlights.summary: Thirty-six trading streets around the lake, dense with street-food stalls, coffee shops and evening crowds.
highlights.transfer: In the city centre. Noi Bai is 40–60 minutes away by airport bus, taxi or Grab, and the quarter itself is walkable.

highlights.title: Ha Long Bay
highlights.summary: Limestone karsts rising straight out of the Gulf of Tonkin, visited by day cruise or overnight boat.
highlights.transfer: About 2.5 hours east of Hanoi by road. Usually taken as a full-day trip or a one-night cruise.

highlights.title: Trang An, Ninh Binh
highlights.summary: A UNESCO-listed karst landscape of rice fields and flooded caves, rowed through by sampan.
highlights.transfer: Roughly 1.5–2 hours south of Hanoi by road or train.
